WP7: "exclude_reward_exclusions" restates the card's exclusion rules; "exclude_emi" kept as an excluded category. The rule pays the base 1% the implicit base already paid, so nothing widens; it was an info earning rule.
WP7: Replaced by card_variant below: UPI earn applies only to the RuPay variant of the card (research note).
WP7: D13b: the rule depends on which card variant the user holds (RuPay only), a user attribute the context does not carry; stays info with depends_on_user_attribute.

WP7: T&C 11.3(b)/(d): value back on "spends on Tata Neu App/Website and partner Tata Brands" (Air India & AI Express, Big Basket, Tata Cliq, Taj, Tata 1MG, Titan & Tanishq, Croma, Westside, Qmin). One list feeds the partner rule and its UPI carve-out, so they always cover the same merchants.
WP7: Tata Neu is now in the brand list itself (it was only implied by the channel text).
WP7: T&C 11.3(e): "UPI Spends : Any UPI Spends on Rupay Credit Card (Including partner Tata Brands) : 1% back as NeuCoins" - so the 2% partner rate must not apply on UPI.

WP7: D25e: T&C 11.4(a) excludes "Merchant EMI - Flexipay" (Infinity) / "Flexipay" (Plus), and 11.6(e) forfeits NeuCoins when "The transaction on which NeuCoins were accrued, got converted to EMI". Rail-EMI exclusion on all spend, as on Millennia (the record's category emi AND rail emi row missed EMI in other categories).
WP7: D25d: T&C 11.4 lists MCC 7349 with rent (6513) and education MCCs 5111, 5192, 5942, 5943, 5947, 8351 besides 8211-8299; the record carried only part of each list.
WP7: D25d: T&C 11.4(a) "NeuCoins will not be accrued for Rental and Government related transactions"; the record's rent row was MCC 6513 only, so a rent-category spend with another or no MCC earned.
